title: asperula aristata subsp. jordanii
intro: Asperula aristata subsp. jordanii, commonly known as Mountain Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating various conditions, such as digestive issues, and its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Wood Sorrel include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for several health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include asperuloside, a glycoside responsible for its medicinal properties, along with other flavonoids and phenolic compounds.
